execution: Photo-metadata workbench with ExifTool 13.55: the fixed selected-field inventoryPhotos of 1 to 16 baseline JPEGs, and inspectMetadata, auditMetadata and compareMetadata over up to 512 JPEG, TIFF, DNG, PNG, WebP and HEIF photos and XMP sidecars from a list or a declared folder, decoded by independent standard-library readers into 40 catalogued typed fields, anchored against a fixed ExifTool listing, with per-source presence states, typed CSVs, a complete media-set manifest and verification that replays the native listing with a trusted runtime; plus editMetadata and removeMetadata, which write new copies of the same container (originals are never modified) after capturing every original byte and publish an output only when independent readback, encoded-image or container-fingerprint preservation and native before/after diff proofs hold; plus reconcileTime and locate, which analyse capture clocks and recorded positions without writing, and correctTime, setLocation and geotagFromTrack, which write new copies with corrected capture times, declared positions or positions interpolated on GPX tracks, from declared domain intent through a plan (apply: plan publishes it without writing; plan applies it later) with the same independent proofs and stable per-item artifact slots; plus copyMetadata and applySidecar, which carry selected typed metadata onto new copies, exportSidecar, planNames and organiseCopies, over JPEG, TIFF, DNG, PNG, WebP and HEIF items (HEIF only through Exif and XMP items that exist); image and text artifacts of earlier operations can be bound as photos, GPX tracks or plan files
